The Beninca TO.GO 433MHz 2-Button Transmitter is compatible with a wide range of Beninca gate and garage door receivers operating on the 433.92 MHz frequency. It is designed to work with systems utilizing the Beninca rolling code protocol.

  • Important: This remote is not compatible with fixed-code systems or different frequency receivers (e.g., 868MHz).
  • Compatible with most Beninca receivers and control boards that support the TO.GO series.
  • Important: If your current remote has a different button colour or frequency, this model may not be compatible. Please contact our support team if you are unsure.
", "instructions": "

Programming via the Receiver

  1. Open the casing of your garage door or gate receiver unit to access the internal circuit board.
  2. Locate the programming button (often labelled PGM, PROG, or SW1) on the receiver board.
  3. Press and release the programming button once; the LED indicator on the receiver should light up or flash.
  4. Press and hold the desired button on your new Beninca TO.GO remote for approximately 2 seconds.
  5. The LED on the receiver will flash or turn off to confirm that the remote has been successfully paired.
  6. Wait 10 seconds for the receiver to exit programming mode and test the remote to ensure it operates the door correctly.

Programming via an Existing Remote

If you have an existing, already-programmed remote, you may be able to program the new remote remotely if your installation allows for 'remote programming'. Please refer to your specific motor or receiver manual for details on enabling this feature, or contact the All Remotes team if you require further assistance.

" }
